description: Phase plan + roadmap excerpt with strategic tradeoffs for strategy-critic baseline. Known issues: (1) CRITICAL — Phase 2 depends on Phase 1's JWT format, but Phase 1 plans to switch from RS256 to HS256 mid-phase, breaking the contract; (2) MAJOR — The chosen Redis-only session store rules out future horizontal scaling without re-architecture; (3) MINOR — Phase ordering puts integration tests after release rather than before.
prompt: Spawn the gsd-critic-strategy agent against PLAN.md and ROADMAP.md in the current sandbox. Read both and identify strategic-misalignment issues: cross-phase contract breaks, future-debt traps, ordering issues. Output JSON with shape: { findings: [{ severity, lane, title, evidence, fix }] }. Be terse — baseline capture.
